addenda.reason: PR #217 review finding F3: R82 ran a registered confirmatory pin whose dispatch label was not the registered pin name; the judge short-circuited it to exploratory_only_model_class with text naming only the corpus-not-public cause
addenda.scope: cause reporting only: not_evaluable_case names every cause and the judge cites the cause recorded on the pin record; no threshold, arithmetic, cell gate, verdict logic or eligibility change; lands forward-only, already-scored runs are never re-scored

amendment_path: post-freeze changes only by numbered addendum (date, reason, exact scope) merged by the owner; any analysis changed by an addendum is reported as exploratory

B1_corpus_nearest_neighbour.spec: retrieve the corpus window nearest the item surface (same backend and the same 13-gram machinery), answer with the gold-shaped token that window carries

B2_random_recombination.calibration: the selftest asserts B2 sits at chance on planted items whose gold is absent from the pool
pool_order: the run's own dispatched item pool at the same family and level, labelled pool=run_pool
B2_random_recombination.pool_provenance_rule: every B2 row records which pool it drew from; a missing public pool is reported, never hidden
B2_random_recombination.spec: answer from the audited public gold pool of the same family and level, drawn by registered RNG (RECOMB_SEED_BASE = 20260202): option_index uniform over the item options, yes_no by the pool-majority label, integer by a pool gold of a different item

B3_smaller_same_family.family_minimum_pin: the smallest checkpoint of a family has no smaller same-family pin: B3 is not_evaluable for it, so it can carry NEGATIVE evidence and a distance report but can never hold a confirmatory cell or a gate
B3_smaller_same_family.not_evaluable_when: no serving endpoint for the partner checkpoint is provided, or the pin is the smallest checkpoint of its family (pins.json smaller_partner null); in that case the pin can hold a NEGATIVE and a distance report but no confirmatory POSITIVE cell
B3_smaller_same_family.spec: the pinned smaller checkpoint of the same family under byte-identical prompts, sampler and item order (pins.json partner field)

baselines.pin_integrity_rule: the calibration arm and the partner arm are checked against the model pin: the calibration records must carry the model pin itself (d_hat is that model's own measured depth) and the partner records must carry exactly the pin named by smaller_partner
baselines.rule: unique only if the base model beats all three; a baseline that is not evaluable blocks the unique claim for that cell, it never waives it

claim.text: A base model (no instruction tuning, no RL, no reasoning prompt) whose training corpus is public produces correct, unique solutions to procedurally novel task instances beyond its measured trained depth.
claim.unique_means: correct AND absent from the model's training corpus AND not reachable by any of the three registered dumb baselines

delivery_census.item_rule: n is the dispatched count, never the answered count; a cell whose n falls below effect.min_n_confirmatory because of dispatch failure is OPEN, not a negative
delivery_census.model_states_source: verify.py DELIVERY_STATES: the judge and the census name the same states
delivery_census.rule: intent to treat: every dispatched item stays in n. A baseline that retrieves nothing scores as a wrong arm (evidence for uniqueness); a baseline with no backend is not_evaluable and blocks the cell; a flagged item stays in n and is excluded from the novelty numerator

effect.interval: Wilson 95% CI on the model cell accuracy; exact McNemar two-sided on the discordant model-vs-best-baseline pairs; the cell passes only if the gap CI lower bound is > 0
effect.multiplicity_correction: holm-bonferroni across the confirmatory cell set, alpha 0.05
effect.primary_statistic: paired accuracy gap Delta = ACC(model) - max over evaluable baselines, on the same items

digit_matrices.novel_item_rule: fresh seed_base derived from the run date; the shipped items/ pools never enter a novel band

ladders.depth_knob: k, the shortest directed path length of the queried pair
ladders.leak_gate: the #67 permutation-calibrated gate plus the #77 relational-feature widening must both pass on the shipped class; an item failing the gate is excluded from the novel band and the exclusion is reported
ladders.novel_item_rule: fresh seed_base; k=1 is a lookup control and never depth evidence (generators/AGENTS.md)

trap_arithmetic.gold_leak_guard: generator surface text carries a '(gold N)' fragment; the judge's prompt builder must strip it and the selftest asserts the stripped prompt contains no gold token (the planted defect)
trap_arithmetic.surface_perturbation: GSM-Symbolic style: the same operation chain on a surprising surface, identical gold; the registered discriminator is the base-vs-trap accuracy gap at matched depth

basis_rule.exact_path: the whole normalized query compared token-boundary to token-boundary against the corpus, so 'no' is not flagged for sitting inside 'nothing'
basis_rule.long_gold: a gold of 3 or more normalized tokens is searched as solution AND surface
basis_rule.near_path: the 13-gram path only runs on a text with at least 13 normalized tokens; a shorter text can hold no 13-gram run and is never flagged for length
basis_rule.short_gold: a gold of fewer than 3 normalized tokens (yes, no, a bare integer) is not a searchable solution string; those items are judged on the item surface alone and the row records basis=surface_only_short_gold

corpus_backends.infinigram: HTTP adapter, base URL from INFINIGRAM_BASE_URL only, never written to any artifact
corpus_backends.live_calls: adapters are inert without the env var; a live corpus query is an owner-approved operation (research/AGENTS.md free-scholarly-APIs protocol plus the metered-spend guardrail). CI never calls a live backend
corpus_backends.local_scan: Aho-Corasick over a corpus slice provided through FROZEN_CORPUS_DIR (stdlib, budgeted by FROZEN_CORPUS_MAX_BYTES)
corpus_backends.olmotrace: HTTP adapter, base URL from OLMOTRACE_BASE_URL only

novelty.flag_rule: one hit flags the item; a flagged item is not unique, is excluded from the numerator and still counted in n (intent to treat)

granularities.exact: normalized full solution string compared against the corpus backend
granularities.near: any run of 13 consecutive normalized word tokens of the solution, or of the item surface, found in the corpus backend

novelty.measurable_rule: a corpus slice that was configured and read is measurable even when it is short: a searched corpus with no match answers clean, not not_evaluable. An unconfigured backend answers not_evaluable, never clean
novelty.not_evaluable_case: a run with no corpus backend - because the training corpus is not public (for example a Qwen-class serving build), because its checkpoint label is not in the confirmatory pin set, or because no corpus slice is configured - can never satisfy the unique criterion; the judge reports the cause recorded for the run and never scores such a run as a negative

prompts.none_reasoning_style: no chain-of-thought instruction, no task-specific hint tokens, one fixed neutral template per family, temperature 0.0, zero-shot; study-design Condition 2
prompts.sampler_frozen_per_round: temperature, max_tokens, seed, top_p and the serving build digest are recorded in the round's sampler.json before dispatch

statistics.cell_interval: Wilson 95% score interval on the model cell accuracy over the dispatched census
statistics.effect_size: gap of at least 0.10 absolute against every evaluable baseline on the same items
statistics.gap_ci_rule: the gap criterion passes when the model Wilson lower bound is strictly above every evaluable baseline accuracy AND the exact McNemar p survives Holm-Bonferroni; both must hold
statistics.gap_test: exact two-sided McNemar on the discordant model-versus-baseline pairs of the same item set; no normal approximation
statistics.multiplicity: holm-bonferroni over the pooled confirmatory beyond-depth cell set of every checkpoint report entering a claim, at alpha 0.05; a checkpoint report applies the same correction to its own cells as a preview, and a claim recomputes it over the pooled set
statistics.no_reanalysis: the statistical parameters here are frozen with the PR; a run may not switch test, alpha, interval or correction afterwards
statistics.recompute_rule: a claim recomputes every checkpoint gate and every cell gate from the cell records it is given; a gate field cached in a report is never trusted
statistics.sidedness: two-sided everywhere; a model that loses to a baseline is reported, never hidden

status: draft (issue #194); becomes the frozen instrument only when the owner merges the prepared PR, and is immutable after that except through amendment_path

trained_depth.definition: the greatest level L in the family grid such that ACC(level) >= 0.80 for every level <= L on the calibration pool
trained_depth.no_delivery_case: distinct from the no-mastery case: if the calibration arm delivered no answer at all (every record at every level is not_delivered), trained depth is not_evaluable, not 0: the cells of that run report a measurement blocker and carry no beyond-depth reading. A censored arm is a delivery failure, never a competence floor.
trained_depth.no_mastery_case: if no level reaches 0.80, d_hat = 0, the whole grid counts as beyond trained depth, and the run must report the model's accuracy floor; a POSITIVE from d_hat = 0 additionally requires ACC(d) >= 0.5 at the reported depth in at least one cell of the family

N1_depth_cliff.measurable_cell: the cell has records and the calibration arm measured ACC(d_hat) > 0
N1_depth_cliff.prose: for every measurable confirmatory beyond-depth cell of the reported checkpoints, ACC(level) < 0.5 x ACC(d_hat)

N2_baselines_match.measurable_cell: the cell has records and at least one evaluable baseline
N2_baselines_match.prose: a registered baseline reaches within 5 percentage points of the model at the novel band in at least two thirds of the measurable confirmatory beyond-depth cells

N3_corpus_answers.measurable_cell: the cell has a configured corpus backend and at least one item with a measured novelty verdict
N3_corpus_answers.prose: mean novelty clean rate below 0.50 across the measurable confirmatory beyond-depth cells: the model's correct answers are corpus matches

N4_no_competence.prose: mean ACC at the novel band at or below 0.05 across the measurable confirmatory beyond-depth cells

NEGATIVE.measurability_rule: each branch fires only over the cells that branch can actually measure, and the branch quantifier runs over that measurable set only. A branch with an empty measurable set is not_evaluable and never fires: an unmeasured cell is silence, not evidence in either direction.
NEGATIVE.prose: a clean negative is an equally valid result and stops the loop. A NEGATIVE is evidence that the claim fails, never the absence of a measurement.

verdicts.OPEN: neither POSITIVE nor NEGATIVE fires: report the distance to each branch and what single measurement would close it

cell_gate.depth_offset_rule: level - d_hat must be one of trained_depth.novel_band_offsets, and level > d_hat
cell_gate.gold_carrying_rule: a trap surface legitimately prints a gold magnitude as a step operand, and the prompt builder licenses that case; those rows are censused and reported as a sensitivity, and a cell where more than this share of prompts carry the gold token is not_evaluable rather than a win

checkpoint_gate.note: POSITIVE is replication across model checkpoints: one round scores one checkpoint, so a single report can meet the family gate but never the checkpoint gate
checkpoint_gate.pin_flags_rule: a pin carrying any of these as true cannot hold a POSITIVE

POSITIVE.prose: the claim holds: a base model with a public corpus produced correct, unique solutions beyond its measured trained depth

unmeasurable_rule.escalation: if no confirmatory cell of a round is measurable, the round is OPEN, the blocker is named, and the loop must not re-run the same unmeasurable configuration
unmeasurable_rule.rule: a cell whose baselines are blocked or whose novelty is not_evaluable can carry neither a POSITIVE nor a NEGATIVE: it is reported as a measurement blocker in the distance list and in the weekly digest
unmeasurable_rule.why: an unconfigured corpus slice or an absent partner endpoint is an operator gap, not a result; treating it as evidence would let a missing measurement produce a clean negative

verdict_level.claim_verdict: POSITIVE / NEGATIVE / OPEN is computed at claim level by score.py --claim over the checkpoint reports it is given
verdict_level.minimum_evidence: no claim verdict without at least 2 confirmatory beyond-depth cells in at least 2 families

minimum_evidence_machine.rule: no claim verdict, POSITIVE or NEGATIVE, without at least 2 confirmatory beyond-depth cells spanning at least 2 task families

verdict_level.negative_needs: one registered branch firing over its measurable cell set with at least 2 families and every counted cell at n >= effect.min_n_confirmatory; a decisive single-pin run is a valid clean negative
verdict_level.positive_needs: at least POSITIVE.checkpoint_gate.min_checkpoints checkpoint reports each meeting the family gate; a single decisive checkpoint can meet the family gate but cannot carry a POSITIVE on its own
verdict_level.single_round_report: a round report carries checkpoint_status (gate_met, families_passed, negative branches seen, blockers) plus the distance list
